engine_parameter_recommendation: Keep retention, accuracy, failure, and timing parameters unchanged from this band analysis. Treat XP-based duration recommendations in methods.txt separately.

correctness_and_kp_comparison.leading_explanation: Target state/history and display threshold crossing, rather than better raw correctness on the current linked KP.
correctness_and_kp_comparison.model_recommendation: Retain topic-level encompassing by default. KP-conditioned coverage is an optional refinement; explicit key-prerequisite links are positive, incomplete annotations, not weight measurements.
correctness_and_kp_comparison.content_prior_caveat: The proposed content prior is a rough starting value. It does not explain every activity effect; credit can rise with zero correct explicitly linked KP questions, and an unchanged band may hide credit.
